title: NBK — What are Couplings? Explanation of Coupling Types and Characteristics
locator: Manufacturer explanation of disc, jaw, beam, Oldham, bellows, rigid and other coupling types and their characteristic trade-offs
notes: Manufacturer-authored taxonomy and product explanation, not a neutral universal selection rule. Design trade-offs must be checked against the actual coupling order code, operating conditions and engineering calculation. No page images or full documents are archived.
